mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_NO productNo , PRODUCT_NAME productName , PRICE price , CATEGORY_NUM categoryNum , CHANGE_NAME changeName FROM TB_PRODUCT
SELECT PRODUCT_NO productNo , PRODUCT_NAME productName , PRICE price , DETAIL_CONTENT detailContent , CHANGE_NAME changeName FROM TB_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_NO =#{productNo}
SELECT C.COLOR_NUM as colorNo , C.COLOR_NAME as colorName FROM TB_COLOR C JOIN TB_OPTION O ON C.COLOR_NUM = O.COLOR_NUM WHERE O.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} GROUP BY C.COLOR_NUM , C.COLOR_NAME
SELECT S.SIZE_NUM as sizeNo , S.SIZE_NAME as sizeName FROM TB_SIZE S JOIN TB_OPTION O ON S.SIZE_NUM = O.SIZE_NUM WHERE O.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} GROUP BY S.SIZE_NUM , S.SIZE_NAME
SELECT CATEGORY_NUM categoryNum , CATEGORY_NAME categoryName FROM TB_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NUM

SELECT PRODUCT_NO productNo , PRODUCT_NAME productName , PRICE price , CHANGE_NAME cahngeName FROM TB_PRODUCT P JOIN TB_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_NUM = C.CATEGORY_NUM WHERE C.CATEGORY_NUM = #{categoryNum}
